alert.notMovable: {{reason}}; original can't be moved: manual action required
alert.writesBlocked: {{reason}}; writes blocked while the file is inaccessible

settings.corruptNotQuarantined: The AI settings are corrupted and couldn't be quarantined ({{error}}). Saving is refused so the original isn't overwritten. Close any other program using this file or check its permissions, then try again.
settings.unreadable: The AI settings can't be accessed right now (read failed). Saving is refused because overwriting the file could lose keys. Make sure no other program is locking it, then try again.

lock.heldByOther: The AI settings are held by another process (PID {{pid}}). Try again in a few seconds.
lock.locked: The AI settings are locked or inaccessible (file "{{path}}"). Try again in a few seconds.

keyfile.randomFailed: Couldn't read random bytes to protect the AI keys: {{error}}
keyfile.invalid: The AI key file "{{path}}" is damaged. Delete it and enter the keys again.
keyfile.unreadable: Couldn't read or create the AI key file: {{error}}
keyfile.decryptFailed: Couldn't read the stored AI key

integration.lostTarget: Integration rejected: link or image lost ({{target}})

http.unreachable: Cannot reach {{url}}. Check that the server is running and that the address is right.

provider.chosenNoKey: The AI chosen in Settings ({{provider}}) has no API key.
provider.invalidUrl: Invalid address: {{url}}. Enter an address starting with http:// or https://, e.g. http://localhost:11434.
provider.urlNotEditable: The address of provider "{{provider}}" cannot be changed.

transcription.inProgress: A transcription is already in progress.

gate.restoring: A restore is already in progress: writing is suspended

structure.lostTarget: Structuring rejected: link or image lost ({{target}})

projects.duplicateName: another project already has this name
projects.inboxLocked: the inbox cannot be renamed, recoloured, archived or deleted
projects.nameTooLong: project name is too long (120 characters max)
projects.needsSpaceToDelete: assign the project to a space before deleting it

backup.blockedAfterRestore: Writes are frozen after a restore: the state of your data may have changed.
backup.commitAmbiguous: Failure while publishing: the state of your data is uncertain ({{error}}).
backup.imageMissingFromFolder: Internal image missing from the folder: {{name}}
backup.imageOutsideFolder: Internal image outside the current folder
backup.imageUrlNotPortable: Internal image URL is not portable
backup.inboxesMultiple: Several Inboxes in the same space
backup.lockPoisoned: The session lock was poisoned by an earlier panic ({{error}})
backup.lockStateInvalid: Internal session lock state is invalid: {{error}}. No data was replaced.
backup.lockUnavailable: Close the other Humcase sessions (MCP, CLI or another window) before restoring: {{error}}
backup.manifestZipMismatch: Manifest and ZIP do not match
backup.noWritableFolder: No accessible folder for the backup ({{error}})
backup.quitAndRestart: Quit Humcase from the notification area icon (Quit), then relaunch the app.
backup.restoreAppliedLockFailed: Restore applied — the restore was published, but the session lock could not be reacquired ({{error}}).
backup.restoreInProgress: A restore is already in progress
backup.restoreNotAppliedLockFailed: Restore not applied — your data is unchanged, but the session lock could not be reacquired ({{error}}).
backup.restoreUncertainLockFailed: Restore in an uncertain state — the failure happened while publishing: your data may have been replaced, and the session lock could not be reacquired ({{error}}).
backup.versionMismatch: Database version does not match the manifest
backup.archiveChanged: The archive has changed since the preview
backup.dictationFragmentsInvalid: Inconsistent raw dictation (note {{id}}): its fragments do not match the raw text
backup.subCasesInvalid: The archive contains a sub-case whose parent case is missing or in another project, or an unknown content kind.
backup.subCasesCycle: The archive contains a case placed inside one of its own sub-cases.
backup.imageFormatUnknown: Invalid image: unrecognized format (PNG or JPEG expected)

data.selfLink: A note cannot be its own task
data.trashedCannotLink: A note in the trash cannot be linked
data.linkedSameProject: Linked notes must belong to the same project
data.targetMustBeTask: The target note must be a task
data.trashedCannotReceiveTask: A note in the trash cannot receive a task
data.trashedCannotFile: A note in the trash cannot be filed.
data.onlyInboxCanBeFiled: Only a note in the Inbox can be filed into a project.
data.destinationMustBeRegular: The destination must be a regular project in the same space as the Inbox.

data.structureEmpty: The original text and the proposal must not be empty
data.contentChanged: The note content has changed; refresh the proposal

data.caseCycle: A case cannot go inside itself or one of its sub-cases.
data.trashedCannotMove: A case in the trash cannot be moved.
data.trashedCannotAnnotate: A case in the trash cannot receive a provenance.
data.restoreParentFirst: The parent case of this sub-case is in the trash. Restore the parent case first.
data.subCaseFollowsParent: A sub-case follows its parent case. File the top-level case instead.
data.sketchInvalid: A drawing only keeps Excalidraw content: this content is not one.

data.linkNotWeb: Only web addresses (http or https) open from a link case.
data.imageTooLarge: Image too large ({{size}} bytes, maximum 20 MB)
data.dbBusy: The database is in use by another program. Try again in a moment.
data.dbReadOnly: The database can only be read: check the permissions of the data folder.
data.dbFull: The disk is full: free some space so Humcase can save.
data.dbIo: The database file could not be read or written ({{error}}).

app.leaseNotHeld: the shared session lock is not held

dataFolder.homeUnavailable: Can't locate your user folder to keep Humcase's data

dataFolder.openAppFirst: Humcase now keeps its data in {{path}}. Open the Humcase application once to move your data there from {{legacy}}, then start this agent again.

dataFolder.webviewCopyFailed: Humcase could not copy the interface's saved state (drafts, preferences) to its new folder: {{error}}

review.inTrash: This case is in the trash.
review.changed: The case changed since you reviewed it: read it again before deciding.
review.notResolved: Only a finished result can be accepted or sent back for rework.
